## Passages
RESULT [agents]: CLIP filtering raised pseudo-label precision from 21.4% to 45.7%. Novel-category AP was 12.0% vs 9.7% for OWL-v2, and 14.2% with verification. Cost per novel category was $0.6, against $1.1 for semi-supervised and $305.2 for fully supervised. Known-category AP held at 26.6%, while the semi-supervised baseline lost 28.7% (catastrophic forgetting).
US [agents]: Almost the same stack as ours (OWLv2 auto-labelling, embedding filter, iterative retraining) in another domain, with published numbers. Adopt: (1) a second-stage crop classifier after OWLv2. Our BioCLIP-2 labeller, 0.986 on cwd12 in Phase A, is the natural analogue of their CLIP filter, and pseudo-label precision should be measured per round. (2) Always re-pseudo-label base (known) species in new [note truncated at collection]
CORRECTION [agents]: Accepted by CVPR 2024. Precision 21.4%->45.7%, novel AP 12.0 vs 9.7 (14.2 after verification), $0.6 vs $1.1 vs $305.2, known AP 26.6% vs semi-supervised -28.7%, 1.75x crop all confirmed.
